::: {.exam-question}
## Question {.question-label}

[**Discuss**]{.task-verb} factors that determine the time to awakening after cessation of a propofol target infusion (TCI).
:::

:::: {#answer-structure}

## Suggested Structure

[**Discuss**]{.task-verb} awakening as the effect-site concentration falling below the individual emergence threshold. Link infusion history, compartment uptake and redistribution, elimination, patient characteristics and other drugs to the time required for this to occur.
